{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='CZ4NH6K']
pp = a.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','instance_family'], columns='date', values='price', aggfunc='max')
chg = pp[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')] != pp[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-12')]
print(chg.sum())
print(pp[pp[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')] != pp[pd.Timestamp('2025-09-01')]])
# num_instances jump check
ni = a.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','instance_family'], columns='date', values='num_instances', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
jump = ni[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')] - ni[[c for c in ni.columns if c < pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')]].mean(axis=1)
print(jump.sort_values().tail(5))"}
